definitions.gloss: to incorporate; to build in; to integrate
definitions.explanation: To include something as an integral part of a larger system, plan, or structure. Commonly used in technical, business, and planning contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{組|く}み{込|こ}む。
⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{機能|きのう}→機能：13165_kinou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{組|く}み{込|こ}まれた。
⟦AI→AI：07764_eeai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{組|く}み{込|こ}む⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are plans to incorporate AI into products.

examples.japanese: ⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{予備費|よびひ}→予備費：noentry⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{組|く}み{込|こ}んで⟦おく→置く：01092_oku⟧⟦べき→べき：10016_beki⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: You should incorporate a contingency fund into the budget.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{設計|せっけい}→設計：03300_sekkei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{安全|あんぜん}→安全：01131_anzen⟧⟦{装置|そうち}→装置：03318_souchi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{最初|さいしょ}→最初：00882_saisho⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{組|く}み{込|こ}まれている。
examples.english: Safety devices have been built into this design from the start.

notes:
FORMATION:
Compound verb: ⟦{組|く}む→組む：02050_kumu⟧ (to assemble) + ～⟦{込|こ}む→込む：noentry⟧ (into). The ～{込|こ}む pattern indicates putting something into, or integrating it into, something else.

ASPECT:
{組|く}み{込|こ}まれている describes a resultant state — "is built in", "has been incorporated" — not an action in progress. This is the most common form in technical writing.

COLLOCATIONS:
・⟦システム→システム：08428_shisutemu⟧に{組|く}み{込|こ}む - to build into a system
・⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧に{組|く}み{込|こ}む - to incorporate into a plan
・⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧に{組|く}み{込|こ}む - to include in a budget
・⟦{設計|せっけい}→設計：03300_sekkei⟧に{組|く}み{込|こ}む - to build into a design
・{組|く}み{込|こ}み⟦システム→システム：08428_shisutemu⟧ - embedded system (technical term)

REGISTER:
Common in technical and business contexts. The noun form {組|く}み{込|こ}み is used as a modifier, as in {組|く}み{込|こ}み⟦ソフトウェア→ソフトウェア：04719_sofutowea⟧ (embedded software).
